title: Language lexicon (lexicon.json) v1
$comment: Plans/Kotlin/EnRuPackPlan.md §5 gap B / UniversalCorePlan.md §3.1 UC-12: lexicon.json is language-scoped lemmas+forms (nouns/adjectives/verbs/personalPronouns/possessives, plus optional morphology/stemAlternations). Deliberately loose on `forms`' own shape: pl's noun/adjective/possessive forms are deep Case×Number(×Gender) tables and its verbs are `present`/`pastStem` objects, while en's are flat invariant/Number-only strings (EnRuPackPlan.md §1.3) — both are valid lexicalized tables for :core-engine's TableMorphology (arbitrary category+lexeme+feature-key lookup, gap B: 'not a gap'), so this schema checks the lexicon's own shape (ids unique-ish, required categories present, forms non-empty), not a fixed per-language form vocabulary. scripts/validate-pack-v2.mjs additionally re-validates pl's lexicon.json via the stricter course-pack-v1.schema.json reconstruction; this schema is the first check that applies to every lang/<code>/lexicon.json, pl included.
